dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: The Tianquan's words can move mountains, and everyone knows it. My task is to help oversee Lady Ningguang's intelligence network.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang's razor-sharp mind tears through vast amounts of information at pace, and quickly reaches a verdict. These pearls of wisdom are then discarded from the Jade Chamber, giving guidance on "prosperity" to the world below...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Do you, too, wish to learn of such things?
